text:
alex: Quick heads-up — doing a short docs grooming sprint this afternoon. I’ll sweep runtime guide anchors, KV-cache docs, and a11y alt text. Who can own the kv-cache + batching docs so I can bundle fixes into one PR?
selena: I can take kv-cache and batching. will skim now, might push a small PR for wording + an example.
pri: I can do the runtime guide anchors and the staging snippet that’s 404'ing. which file is that again?
docs-bot: scan-report: http://internal.docs/reports/link-scan/1739987650 — found 6 dead anchors, 2 image 403s, 1 snippet 404 in /runtime/cache/kv-cache.md
alex: thanks — the snippet 404 is in /runtime/cache/kv-cache.md near the "usage" section. pri, I’ll DM the exact stack trace + repro.
selena: quick note: batching doc needs a tiny config example. Suggest adding this: ```yaml batching: { max_batch_size: 8, prefer_latency: true }```
pri: got it. also the runtime guide has a stray frontmatter key that breaks the TOC rendering on staging. I’ll open a small PR to strip the key.
ryan: tagging in — i can review selena's PR when it's up, ping me with the link.
selena: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1428 — fixes kv-cache wording + config snippet.
ryan: LGTM, left one tiny nit about capitalization. will approve after that.
pri: PR for runtime frontmatter fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1429 — also fixed that 404 snippet by re-hosting asset.
alex: awesome, thanks both. can we aim to merge both before EOD? i’ll do a final smokecheck on staging after merges.
selena: aiming for < 2 hours.
pri: same here, will monitor the staging preview and report any regressions.
docs-bot: deploy-bot: staging preview generated for PR 1428 and 1429 — https://staging.docs-review/1739987650
ryan: I pulled the staging preview, snippets look fixed. one more tiny alt text tweak on the runtime image, pushed a commit to 1428.
alex: perfect. I’ll mark ownership on the docs tracker: https://internal.task/KB-487 (owner: selena, co-owner: pri).
selena: noted. leaving a short PR description for future maintainers about the batching example tradeoffs.
pri: ping me if anything else flaps in staging, will be near my laptop. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks team — will follow up in standup tomorrow with quick status.
ryan: cheers.
